name: high-key-white-monolith
prompt: A tall portrait photograph of an enormous, empty, pure white room where the floor curves up into the walls with no visible corner or edge, like an endless gallery sweep. Exactly in the middle of the frame rises a single colossal stack of white office paper, squared off as cleanly as a carved block, its sheets pressed so tight the sides read as fine horizontal lines; it towers far above everyone and nearly touches the top of the frame. At its foot, small and centred, a plain white card label printed in neat black sans-serif capitals reads "THE RULES". In front of the stack, in the lower third, five people stand in a straight, evenly spaced row, seen mostly from behind and slightly turned, heads tipped back to stare up at the paper. Each wears a thick hand-knitted wool balaclava in its own loud solid colour, hot pink, lime green, cobalt blue, tangerine and lemon yellow, covering the whole head with no eye, nose or mouth openings. The figure on the far right has turned their head over the shoulder toward the camera, showing the mask's front: a wide white knitted ring stitched around the whole face, and inside the ring, high and off to the right side of the picture at about two o'clock, a solid red knitted triangle sitting over the wearer's left eye; the others show the same red triangle at the edge of their turned profiles. They wear plain modern clothes, black hoodies, grey zip jackets, dark trousers and trainers, with the balaclavas tucked into their collars, black gloves on both hands and sleeves pulled over the wrists, no skin visible anywhere. The light is bright, flat and even from every direction, soft and almost shadowless, with only a faint grey contact shadow under each pair of feet. Camera far back at chest height, perfectly level and symmetrical, a long lens so the stack and the row of people sit dead centre in a vast field of white. Palette: white on white with soft pale greys, the only colour in the whole picture being the bright masks and their small red triangles. Crisp, clean, photographic, high-key.
